tools.name: list_series
tools.description: Free. What this engine covers, the publisher and as-of date behind each series, and the no-guess rule.

tools.name: route_claim
tools.description: Free. Shows which series a claim would be routed to, the value and date extracted, and the signals behind the score. Returns NO verdict — pay for check_figure when you want one.

tools.name: check_figure
tools.description: Submit the dated figure you are about to act on. Returns verified, stale, contradicted or unknown, cited to the publisher's own series with its as-of date. Use before committing a number to a page, deck or decision. Not advice. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict,

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Verify a legal entity: does this company exist, under which identifier and jurisdiction, and is its registration current? Cited to open primary registers (the GLEIF LEI index and US SEC EDGAR). Returns found, ambiguous, not_found or unknown; a near name match is never reported as a match. Not advice

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Private data: verify_citation, watch_add, watch_portfolio, check_document · Public sink: check_figure, verify_citation, verify_package, watch_add, verify_bulk, check_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Private data: verify_citation, watch_add, watch_portfolio, check_document · Public sink: check_figure, verify_citation, verify_package, watch_add, verify_bulk, check_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "watch_add" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
